details.description: Introducing the Maxo Genius Combi, the ultimate mosquito repellent that automatically adapts to your needs. Powered by the innovative Intellichip technology, this device seamlessly switches between two modes - Attack and Defend - to provide maximum protection against mosquitoes. In the high-powered Attack mode, the Maxo Genius Combi delivers an instant vapour blast to tackle severe mosquito infestations, while the Defend mode offers a steady, low-level vapour flow for continuous, uninterrupted protection. Voted as the Product of the Year in 2017 in the Insect Repellent category, this device is the result of a survey of over 2,000 people by Nielsen, ensuring it meets the needs of discerning consumers. With the Maxo Genius Combi, you can enjoy a peaceful, mosquito-free environment, whether you're relaxing at home or venturing outdoors.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Plug in the machine and switch it on.
2. The machine will automatically shift between Attack and Defend modes.
details.storageInstructions: *Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight

Maxo Anti-Mosquito Racquet is a lightweight, portable device designed for instant and effective mosquito control. Ideal for both indoor and outdoor use, it helps protect your family from mosquitoes that spread dengue, malaria, and chikungunya. Instant mosquito kill: 2,200V DC voltage eliminates mosquitoes on contact. Long battery life: Rechargeable 350mAh battery ensures extended use and lasting performance. 2-watt LED light attracts mosquitoes to the mesh for increased effectiveness. Maximum coverage: Large net area and unique design enhance mosquito control. Strong and durable: Sturdy yet lightweight build for easy handling and durability. Warranty: Claim a 6-month warranty by registering on the website mentioned on the pack within 10 days of purchase. Easy to use and charge: Anti-fall wire system for safe and convenient charging. Shockproof system: Human-friendly, shockproof mesh ensures safety during use.
details.storageInstructions: * Keep the device away from excess moisture * Avoid storing in locations where there are flammable gases and liquids around
details.usageInstructions: 1. For the first use and each subsequent charge, charge the Maxo Racquet for 6-8 hours. 2. Press the switch to activate the mesh current. 3. To clean the dead mosquitoes stuck to the mesh, simply tap or shake the device slightly.
